profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Sr. Database administrator (DBA) with over 10 years of experience designing, installing, configuring, troubleshooting databases running on native hardware or virtual environment…testing and supporting next-generation database solutions in MS SQL Server Enterprise environments. Proficient in an assortment of technologies, including MS SQL Server 7, 2000, 2008, MS Failover Cluster, SQL LiteSpeed, PostgreSQL, Access, ODBC, Visio, Java, C#, Perl, XML, SVN, SCOM, MS Orchestrator, Windows and Linux

DBA skills include:
• SQL Server Database Administration	
• Performance Tuning & Capacity Monitoring
• Data Security, Backup & Recovery
• Failover Cluster Configuration & Administration
• Database server consolidation & Virtualization	
• Bidirectional Transactional Replication
• Log Shipping
• Data Encryption
• Data archival
• Performance Collection

Recent Projects:
• Lead DBA at Varolii in the consolidation of four Data Centers into two. The Consolidation included 20 productions SQL Server, supporting configurations including standalone instances, Fail-over Clustering and transactional replication
• Designed and completed the implementation of Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) on all production and Beta SQL Servers. Designed the company’s TDE Encryption Key/Certificate management Standard Operating Procedure
• Project lead in the analysis of database hardware utilization for schema, instance consolidation and OS virtualization, provided guidelines configuring and running databases on virtualized OS
• Developed a .NET C# Service Application for collecting performance counters from Windows OS and SQL Servers, utilizing a central database for storage, used for performance analysis and presentation of performance graphs

positions.title: Senior Database Administrator
positions.description:
Manage SQL Server database administration assignments for 24x7x365 production environments supporting multiple OLTP databases and Beta environments. Provide database support for development and QA databases instances. Enhance database performance, perform restores, implement data recovery procedures, handle performance tuning and conduct regular system backups. Ensure technical and functional designs meet business requirements.

• Developed a fully automated process for archiving backups that removes all indexes and restores them after backup restore, resulting in reduction of disk space requirement by 50%. The process uses SQL LiteSpeed data compression for further disk space reduction and AES 256-bit encryption
• Served as lead DBA in the planning and completion of the upgrade of all SQL Servers to version 2008; database upgrades ranged from mission critical OLTP databases running on SQL Server 2008 Failover cluster to single instance configuration. Provided hardware requirements, documented upgrade procedures and implementations
• Enhanced and tested storage strategies and disaster-recovery plan for all mission critical operational databases, delivering solution that guaranteed recovery performance and high availability; solutions included Failover Clustering, on-site and off-site Transactional Replication and Log shipping

positions.title: Database Programmer / Web Application - Contract
positions.description:
Collaborated with software engineers and marketing to complete the company’s SaaS cloud base Application. Completed an estimated nine weeks project in six weeks and included functionality intended to be introduce in the second release of the application.

• Design and modified web pages using an in-house development environment
• Created and tested of all high level SQL related functions in the product
• Created and modified PostgreSQL tables, views, functions and triggers

positions.title: Database Administrator / Senior Web Developer / Application Developer
positions.description:
Managed and supported databases development and methodologies. Evaluated the physical and logical design of databases to keep up with a growing business needs. Duties included data backup, data recovery, performance tuning, data integrity, and modeling of new and existing databases. 
• Managed and performed backup/restore and replication of databases for data recovery
• Managed users privileges, identify security issues and available service packs and updates
• Project manager for team projects, including migrations of multiple SQL Server 7 to SQL Server 2000

Managed the transformation of the business functional requirements into efficient, high quality web-based applications and provide technical solutions to meet ever-increasing complex industry and internal system challenges.
• Redesigned and maintained an e-commerce site using ASP, Site Server and SQL Server where thousands of mortgage lenders could requests their customers credit report
• Worked with and mentored several developers during the migration of the company’s e-commerce site from a Microsoft (ASP/IIS) Intel platform to a (JSP/Servlets/Applets/Tomcat) Unix platform
• Build tools (using ASP/JSP/Unix script/SQL Server Jobs) for monitoring internal applications to ensure 24x7 services availability

Member of the R&D department responsible for the architecture, design, development and support of multi-tire J2EE and Visual Basic applications, that supports the delivery of Mortgage Credit Reports to thousands of nationwide clients.
• Design, developed and documented J2EE applications deployed in Borland AppServer
• Setup SonicMQ Broker for the reliable delivery of Java Messages and events to J2EE applications
• Build reliable and stable EJB that perform XML data processes that supports web services
• Maintained Visual Basic COM objects that performed data parsing and database entry and updates
• Setup and supported Microsoft SourceSafe for the source code of the R&D department
